name: チャンネル権限の同期案内
prompt:
Create the second render of this same Japanese permission-sync notice. Preserve the exact text, colors and button style. This is only a crop and button-geometry correction.

The output must use the native 390x118 short-wide crop (aspect about 3.31:1), without extra vertical white canvas. Keep the sentence 「この権限は分類「交流の会話」と同期していません。」 at x16 y11 in one muted-gray line.

Make the pale-mint rounded action button x16 y46, width358 and height58, ending at x374 and y104. In v001 the button ends too far left (about x353), starts about 5px too low, and is about 5px too short. Extend it to the native right edge and raise its top to y46 while preserving the same bottom. Put the small forest-green down-chevron near x34 y72 and the dark-green bold label 「今すぐ同期」 at x72 y67. Do not make the label blue: this is a button action, not a hyperlink.

No hyperlink text appears in this component. The blue Edit label from the full source screenshot is outside the selected crop and must not be added. Do not substitute sync arrows for the native down-chevron. Keep the background white and add no other controls or content. Use the native preview for exact crop and geometry; use v001 only for its rendering style.
reviewNotes: v002を実画像で目視。日本語案内と「今すぐ同期」ボタン、下向きシェブロンを保持。リンク文言なし。出力2176x722はnative390x118に対してまだ3.01:1（native3.31:1）。ボタン幅は約344pxでnative358pxより狭く、高さは約52pxで58pxより短い。ボタン上端はおよそy41でnative y46より高く、下端も早い。2回の限定試行を保存しneeds-correctionのまま次へ進む。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
